Messages.Author: bastian
Messages.Body:
I need some help with the deck below. Obviously the idea is to bleed with dominate, and stealth/ block fail with necromancy. Basic bounce module to keep you alive. Temporis to add some nifty tricks to help with ousting.
Agent of Power is there to bring some surprises, give temporis to nerds, or perhaps give Krassimir DOM every now and then (if the seal isn't installed).

Well really, the deck is quite easy to comprehend so I'll just post it here and hope that you'll have some helpful comments
